name: Temporary residence and work permit / Single Permit (jednolite zezwolenie na pobyt czasowy i pracę)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a job offer from an employer registered/resident in Poland, who initiates the application at the relevant voivodeship office.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from a Polish-registered employer.

requirements.blocker_text: Gross salary must be at least the national minimum wage (PLN 4,806/month from 1 Jan 2026) and not lower than what Polish employees earn in comparable positions.
requirements.fix_path: Negotiate a salary at or above the current statutory minimum wage.

requirements.blocker_text: For most occupations the employer must first obtain a starosta's confirmation that the position cannot be filled from the local labour market (test rynku pracy) before applying for the Type A work-permit component; several occupations and nationalities are exempt.
requirements.fix_path: Employer completes the labour-market test process, or confirms the role/nationality falls under an existing exemption.

evidence_required.document: Employment contract or job offer meeting salary and comparability conditions
Appendix 1 to the application, completed by the employer
Proof of accommodation and health insurance in Poland

outcome.duration_length: up to 3 years (exceptionally up to 5 for large employers), tied to the employment contract length
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: continuous legal residence, breaks no longer than 6 months at a time and no more than 10 months total within the 5-year window

sources.title: Migrant.info.pl (IOM / Polish Ministry of Interior co-funded portal) -- Residence and work permit (Single Permit)
Ministerstwo Rodziny, Pracy i Polityki Społecznej -- 2026 minimum wage announcement

notes: STRUCTURAL FINDING: this route absorbed the largest single procedural overhaul found anywhere in the Poland build. From 1 January 2026, the old Type A/B/C/D/E work-permit application names were formally retired under the new Ustawa z dnia 20 marca 2025 r. o warunkach dopuszczalności powierzania pracy cudzoziemcom -- Type A became ZC-WWZPP, Type B became ZC-WWZF, and Types C/D/E merged into ZC-WWZD, confirmed via zielonalinia.gov.pl (a Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy-run public information line). Multiple secondary sources dated mid-2026 still describe 'Type A/B/C' as if current -- a direct live-staleness catch, the same failure mode as the UK/Germany/Netherlands salary-threshold catches, except here it's a naming/procedural overhaul rather than a numeric threshold. Renamed labels are noted for completeness but the underlying legal mechanism (employer-initiated single decision combining work authorisation and temporary residence, issued by the voivode) is unchanged. Minimum wage rose to PLN 4,806/month (PLN 31.40/hour) from 1 Jan 2026, per Ministry announcement -- this is the wage floor for standard Single Permit and work-permit salary conditions generally, distinct from and much lower than the EU Blue Card's 150%-of-average-wage threshold (see pl_eu_blue_card). pr_after_months and citizenship_after_months use the standard 5-year continuous-residence figures confirmed directly in Poland's Act on Foreigners (ustawa o cudzoziemcach) via multiple voivodeship-office and mos.cudzoziemcy.gov.pl pages -- see pl_permanent_residence and pl_naturalisation for the underlying route-level detail and the faster alternate paths (marriage to a Polish citizen, Karta Polaka) that this route can feed into.
